prioritizedRemaining.feature: 微信 / QQ 真机验收
prioritizedRemaining.need: 用户暂缓安装与实机应用验收；只使用模拟器自有编辑器，不能据此声称微信/QQ通过。
当前保留既有内测签名以覆盖安装；需要用户自行保管正式发布密钥及迁移方案。
上一版部署时系统盘约313 MiB、数据盘约51 GiB；本轮仅在已授权数据盘发布，实时余量见部署报告。仍需监控系统盘增长，不能清理其他项目或数据库。

prioritizedRemaining.feature: 真实视觉模型与长截图识别验收
prioritizedRemaining.need: 本轮使用本地合成接口验证流程和真实上传像素；原图最长边仍为2048，复杂长截图可能损失文字。需用户主动使用自己的视觉模型核对，不自动调用付费AI。

prioritizedRemaining.feature: 账号注销及加密同步空间管理
prioritizedRemaining.need: 已具备注册、登录、恢复码、退出和加密同步；无用户自助注销接口、远程同步空间删除/容量管理。断开同步只移除本机同步码。须设计明确确认、权限和兼容策略后实施。

prioritizedRemaining.feature: 按聊天对象保存关系偏好
prioritizedRemaining.need: 已有常用人设、AI生成人设、通用关系/场景/亲密度/目标和开场话题；缺少用户手动建立的对象偏好档案，不应自动读取联系人或聊天。
已有文本表情、颜文字和3张原创PNG，主应用分享/键盘兼容插入；缺少自定义图片包导入、图片收藏/最近使用及更多原创素材。

prioritizedRemaining.feature: 输入质量和兼容性基准
prioritizedRemaining.need: 本轮235项既有偏好/词库检查与全键盘/九宫格单手切换回归通过；仍缺同设备长句、新词、中英混输、低内存与耗电基准，不宣称达到竞品输入质量。
iOS项目不等于可交付iPhone包；原生自备API/草稿同等能力、Mac/Xcode和签名验收仍缺。

prioritizedRemaining.feature: 连续/离线语音和更多输入布局
prioritizedRemaining.need: 当前主动录音最长20秒，联网识别后预览确认；缺连续听写和离线语音。手写、双拼、更多方言覆盖可后排。
依用户要求免费、自备API；不作为本轮缺陷，保持关闭。

privacy.imageEditing: Crop removes pixels outside selection; masks are opaque pixels burned into a new in-memory image. No edit layer, source URI or EXIF is forwarded. Only explicit recognize/generate sends the current image.
privacy.recognition: Editable result; <=1000 characters required at confirmation, no silent truncation. Confirm removes image and generates only after another explicit tap. Text follows existing local draft settings.
privacy.apiProfiles: AES-GCM Android Keystore; separate keys for up to8 profiles. Public metadata excludes secrets. New profile cannot inherit another profile key. Active single-record format retained for older APK compatibility. Backup/sync do not export provider keys.
privacy.recentTools: Only up to4 tool IDs; no clipboard, surrounding chat or input content.

apiCompatibilityValidation: Synthetic encrypted roundtrip of legacy active record, edited-by-old-format merge, max8 and profile isolation. Actual downgrade installation was not performed.

principles: contrast: one primary action with secondary editing controls
alignment: consistent card gutters and image selection canvas
repetition: shared action components and tool labels
proximity: API connection/tests and screenshot actions grouped
layout.touch: Actions >=48dp; two configurable middle toolbar slots; AI and More fixed
layout.fallbacks: Typing-only one-hand; AI/settings/expression panels full width. <340dp or landscape full-width fallback. 200% content can scroll without losing image drag.

limits: Requires OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint; /models may be unsupported, manual model entry remains available.
Model list does not establish image capability; synthetic digits test verifies basic support only.
Real-provider OCR quality, long screenshots and physical IME compatibility still need user acceptance.
Existing internal-test signing retained; owner-controlled release key/migration and iPhone build remain pending.
Backend unchanged at free-personal-1.25.0; formal sales remain disabled.
